texts.preamble: Mahkar Singh vs State Of U.P. on 30 November, 2023 Author: Samit Gopal Bench: Samit Gopal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ? Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:226521 Court No. - 69 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 3567 of 2016 Revisionist :- Mahkar Singh Opposite Party :- State of U.P. Counsel for Revisionist :- Arvind K. Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J. 1.
texts.facts: 5. The prosecution case as per the complaint filed by the Food Inspector F.G. Safdar is that on 18.06.2003 at about 09:30 am while doing inspection at Railway Station, Platform No. 1, Gajraula he introduced himself to the revisionist and found 7 liters milk stored which was to be used for the rail passengers by making tea. He purchased 750 ml mixed milk from the revisionist by giving money. He prepared samples of the same. The milk was found to be having milk fat less by 57% and milk solid not fat less by 8%. It is alleged that after filing of the complaint, notice under Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act was sent to the revisionist.
texts.arguments: 6. Learned counsel for the revisionist argued that the revisionist is the only servant of the M/s Bhure Lal and Sons and he has nothing to do with the material available in the said stall. It is argued that there is no independent witness to the same. It is further argued that both the witnesses are persons of food inspector in which witness Ashok Kumar was neither examined nor produced before the concerned trial court. It is argued that the milk as kept in the shop was not displayed for sale but even as per the prosecution case was for making tea for passengers and persons at the railway station. It is argued that as such conviction and sentence as awarded to the revisionist be set-aside, judgement & order of the trial court be set-aside and also the judgement & order of the appellate court be set-aside.
